title: checkAPIs.pl: Show errors as red in console
description: This is an attempt to make pipeline failures stand out more.

notes.body:
It can be difficult to see the cause of a failing pipeline - have included a deliberate dissector error to see this trigger (on the 'Commit Check').

Example of hard-to-see errors:
![image](/uploads/5722ca17d0abe7fd354ccf41aa1a1823/image.png){width=1225 height=55}

Are there other/better ways to do this?

As expected these these types of errors do show in red with this change:

![image](/uploads/0f4c12cc258c70e3984dd1b5292e8fa7/image.png){width=1290 height=76}

added 1 commit
  • c3b68f70 - checkAPIs.pl: Show errors as red in console
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/20809/diffs?diff_id=1451870531&start_sha=5f7ceb755614c2bdc612deb8d5693bf9c3c9cf4f)
This will run on developer's machine if they install the git hook. It seems that Term::ANSIColor should be there from Perl 5.8 (July 2002) onwards...
Another option that might help is to stop pipelines at the first failing error.  So if the last lines showing were these errors, it'd be more obvious that they were important.
For some of the "batch warning fixes" you do, I think you'll like it better if it shows errors for all dissectors, not just the first one when you have 10 dissectors changed.

I take your point.  As I was saying to Jaap, ideally developers would have installed the commit_msg hook, which covers all/most(?) of the same checks, and that it 'Commit Check' fails we could consider printing encouragement to copy tools/commit_msg into ./git/hooks.

Anyway, I'm going to merge this as-is, as I think it will be helpful.
enabled an automatic merge when all merge checks for c3b68f7000f6215aad2d4dc95badc572e858e4c9 pass
